claim.value: Cases still unresolved at the board deadline should be reported as unresolved without forced closure.
claim.scope: The treatment of residual uncertainty at the reporting deadline.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly directs reporting unresolved cases without forcing closure at the board deadline.

signal_basis.value: Comparison of documentary traces leaves cases unresolved at the board deadline: multiple histories may fit surviving records, and exhausting identified sources may leave documented uncertainty.
signal_basis.scope: Residual uncertainty about individual orders after record investigation, as it stands at the reporting deadline.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the record comparison, possible non-uniqueness, uncertainty remaining after source exhaustion, and deadline treatment.
The bounded reporting instruction requires no additional empirical relation.

rationale: When the investigation leaves a case unresolved, reporting that uncertainty accurately reflects the evidence. The deadline supplies no additional evidence that would justify closure. The claim licenses only preserving unresolved status in reporting.
uncertainty: The historical approval status may remain unknown; that uncertainty supports the specified reporting treatment.
